head: 86f0fa284e0837e6b877d7add07c1448a4fde88a

findings.issue: fixed: A deduplicated FRESH WAITING updates its item timestamp but not the recovery index. With reason A at 0, reason B at 1, A again at 300000 and RECOVERED at 300002, recovery checks expired B and misses eligible A, leaving both decisions open.
fixed: window_ms=True passes isinstance(..., int) and silently becomes a one-millisecond correlation window instead of rejecting a malformed configuration value.

needs-human: different positive window_ms values change correlation under the same policyVersion, but state and receipts do not record the window. Choose the immutable version/configuration contract before changing this API.

needs-human: CRITICAL permits direct RESOLVE and permanently leaves the queue; the existing test explicitly expects this. Issue #9's proposal permits acknowledge only, while its acceptance text only forbids dismiss. Clarify audited manual resolution.
needs-human: ACKED BLOCKING items remain in queue(), whereas issue #9 describes persistence until ack/resolve. Decide whether ACK stops reminders, removes the decision from the queue, or both.

needs-human: nonnegative decision times can precede the source event or previous receipt (ERROR at 1000, ACK at 900, RESOLVE at 800); a backdated snooze can hide a current decision. Define item/clock ordering and clock-skew handling before adding a persisted time contract.

needs-human: equal-timestamp WAITING and RECOVERED events are ordered by eventId, so swapping arbitrary IDs changes whether the wait auto-resolves. Define simultaneous-event causality or a trusted source sequence before changing this correlation policy.

summary: Fixed stale recovery indexing after reason-specific WAITING deduplication and boolean correlation-window validation; both regressions failed first, and all 150 selected tests, including 15 replay tests, pass in Git Bash (exit 0). needs-human: settle version/configuration binding, CRITICAL resolution, BLOCKING acknowledgement, decision-clock ordering and equal-timestamp causality; fixed=false because these findings remain open. The broader Node baseline has an unrelated local runtime-config drift failure; packaged runtime and real multi-agent acceptance remain deferred.
